比率；速度；评估；被列为；划分等级

examples.text: His last book was completed in 1909, one year before his death.
examples.translation: 他的最后一本书完成于1909年，也就是他去世的前一年。
examples.speechText: His last book was completed in 1909, one year before his death.

examples.text: This situation changed, however, when suddenly factories began dumping enormous quantities（quantity的复数形式） of materials into the seas.
examples.translation: 然而，当工厂突然开始向海洋倾倒大量物质时，这种情况就改变了。
examples.speechText: This situation changed, however, when suddenly factories began dumping enormous quantities of materials into the seas.

examples.text: The underlined word "they" refers to group discussions.
examples.translation: 划线单词“they”指的是小组讨论。
examples.speechText: The underlined word "they" refers to group discussions.

examples.text: Refilling a bottle, rather than throwing it away, has become a popular way for people to reduce waste.
examples.translation: 给瓶子重新灌装，而不是直接扔掉，已经成为人们减少浪费的一种流行做法。
examples.speechText: Refilling a bottle, rather than throwing it away, has become a popular way for people to reduce waste.

examples.text: Because of this guilt, many people force themselves to go out even when staying at home makes more sense.
examples.translation: 由于这种内疚，即使待在家里更合理，许多人仍会勉强自己出门。
examples.speechText: Because of this guilt, many people force themselves to go out even when staying at home makes more sense.

examples.text: The exercise is also great for improving blood pressure and heart rate.
examples.translation: 这项运动也非常有助于改善血压和心率。
examples.speechText: The exercise is also great for improving blood pressure and heart rate.

examples.text: I don't just watch them on television.
examples.translation: 我不只是在电视上看他们。
examples.speechText: I don't just watch them on television.

examples.text: From a plane, cars on the highway look like ants.
examples.translation: 从飞机上看，高速公路上的汽车就像蚂蚁一样。
examples.speechText: From a plane, cars on the highway look like ants.

examples.text: By implementing these strategies, we can boost our health in cold weather.
examples.translation: 通过实施这些方法，我们能在寒冷天气里改善健康状况。
examples.speechText: By implementing these strategies, we can boost our health in cold weather.

examples.text: The body makes energy from food,” he argues（argue的第三人称单数形式）, “so it could possibly also power a phone.
examples.translation: 他辩称：“人体从食物中获取能量，因此也有可能为手机供电。”
examples.speechText: The body makes energy from food,” he argues, “so it could possibly also power a phone.

examples.translation: 我很感谢他们付出的努力。

examples.text: She performs physics experiments in theatres.
examples.translation: 她在剧院里进行物理实验。
examples.speechText: She performs physics experiments in theatres.

examples.text: At the time of economic crisis, he could only earn a salary of $ 2,000 per month.
examples.translation: 经济危机期间，他每月只能挣到两千美元的工资。
examples.speechText: At the time of economic crisis, he could only earn a salary of $ 2,000 per month.

examples.text: They were fond of hearing from their grandparents.
examples.translation: 他们过去很喜欢收到祖父母的消息。
examples.speechText: They were fond of hearing from their grandparents.

examples.text: Strong winds blow all the time towards the equator and then to the west.
examples.translation: 强风持续吹向赤道，随后转向西方。
examples.speechText: Strong winds blow all the time towards the equator and then to the west.
